scope: Legacy ML anomaly all-location and explicit sensor query behavior
focused_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_ml_anomaly_scope.py tests/test_ml_anomaly.py tests/test_anomaly_detector_cli_scope.py tests/test_runtime_import_regressions.py -q
checks: sensor discovery preserves source location and enforces sensor/device location agreement
all-location Prophet and Isolation Forest work is independently grouped by location
same-time anomaly results from separate locations remain distinct
explicit sensor selection binds training and prediction reads, bypasses the incompatible location/type cache, and skips multivariate scoring
malformed ML sensor UUID is rejected before database access
sensor-specific persisted training is rejected before database access because the cache is location/type-scoped
runtime SQL and worker SQL saved inventory regressions pass
worker source closure, function reachability, SQL reachability, boundary, effect, job-contract, and runtime SQL inventories regenerate and pass current-source checks
Kernel requirement groups and optional provider import boundaries pass
limitations: Baseline and ML CLI paths still use the legacy shared database identity; signed worker isolation remains open.
The checks do not provide populated-data model accuracy or farm-output parity.
